reason: On my money, 55 CZK for one can is a lot when water costs me nothing and a coffee at the petrol station is cheaper and already part of my routine. And it isn't even sold at the petrol stations where I actually stop, so I'd have to order it online or find a café.
objection: 55 CZK a can is too much for something I'd drink before a run when water and coffee already do the job. Also, the label is in English, so I'm not sure it's even a Czech product.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the petrol station fridge at around 35 CZK, so I could grab one on a long drive or before a weekend ride.
